title: ロボティクス統合演習
subtitle: Robotics Integrated Exercise
educationalGoal: With the development of AI, the realization of motion intelligence in robotics has become important. In this course, students learn physical body movements in the real world comprehensively through mathematical pendulum models. First, students learn to analyze a pendulum as a dynamical system. Next, students learn to stabilize an inverted pendulum by modern control based on the model. Then, students learn to control the inverted pendulum based on data-driven machine learning. MATLAB/Python is used in this course.
advice: The student should have an understanding of the fundamentals of linear algebra, analysis and dynamics. It is also necessary to understand the fundamentals of system control (control engineering). For preparation, the lecture material will be presented before the class, so students should check the necessary information in advance. For review, students are expected to solve the exercise reports given in the class by themselves and clarify any unclear points by the next class.

              1.Pendulum and Dynamical Systems
2.Inverted Pendulum and Modern Control
3.Inverted Pendulum and Machine Learning

              With the development of AI, the realization of motion intelligence in robotics has become important. In this course, students learn physical body movements in the real world comprehensively through mathematical pendulum models. First, students learn to analyze a pendulum as a dynamical system. Next, students learn to stabilize an inverted pendulum by modern control based on the model. Then, students learn to control the inverted pendulum based on data-driven machine learning. MATLAB/Python is used in this course.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The student should have an understanding of the fundamentals of linear algebra, analysis and dynamics. It is also necessary to understand the fundamentals of system control (control engineering). For preparation, the lecture material will be presented before the class, so students should check the necessary information in advance. For review, students are expected to solve the exercise reports given in the class by themselves and clarify any unclear points by the next class.
